During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a '''neuromuscular disorder''' affected a number of [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] veterans of the [[Galactic War]] against the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. The source was eventually determined to be exposure to toxic smoke during the [[Sacking of Coruscant]].<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Bioanalysis|Reopening Old Wounds}}</ref>
